about: Bundle-only normalisation data for bootstrap.py. When exporting Claude-web bundle zips, bootstrap.py normalises the bundle copy of each included entry's root SKILL.md so it passes strict upload surfaces: frontmatter keys outside the Agent Skills spec are removed from the bundle copy, display names that are not valid skill IDs are replaced, and the descriptions listed under yaml_repairs are double-quoted. Repository copies are never modified, and every change is disclosed in the zip's BUNDLE-NORMALISATION.md member. The slugifier used when no name_override applies is: lowercase, replace each maximal run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with one hyphen, strip leading/trailing hyphens, truncate to 64 characters then strip any trailing hyphen. spec_keys and reserved_name_words are pinned to the documented values (spec_keys: name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools; reserved_name_words: anthropic, claude) and the run aborts if they differ.

layout_exclusions.reason: the entry is template files (MEMORY.md, SCAFFOLDING.md, USER.md, daily-note.md, loop-card.md, people-index.md) with no SKILL.md; it is not a skill and its zip is a plain archive, not an upload

yaml_repairs.reason: description is a plain scalar containing ': ' (e.g. 'keynote: the real product'), which YAML rejects; the bundle copy double-quotes it, text unchanged
